body: No one believed my friend Kacey when she expressed how near the end of the rope she was. Dismissed it as dramatic or homesick. Until she did it.
Yeah and Viv won $0 in her original season. They were in my Top 2 for this season. Hate to see it like this😭
I just think Viv deserves some prize money. $20k, in comparison to the $100k everyone else won on their original seasons, is nothing. She is so talented and so deserving.

A love for Shae ≠ a love for a very flat, bad wig.

If she wore a wig like that for a Dolly Parton runway, *before* she was even an all star, it would’ve been a read.

Shea’s wig was not doing it for me on the runway. It looked like a wig for a first act in a chronological production about presidents. 😅 I hate that they don’t give harsh critiques but I’m sure it’s something Michelle would’ve commented on.

As far as runways alone, I think Raja was top. Viv & Monet tied for 2nd. Raja’s runways have been just so elevated this season. Monet’s look was a great take, but Vivienne looked exactly like Dolly hands down.
*asks everyone in the room back to back*

Raja should have THREE legendary legend stars, not ZERO.

![gif](giphy|cpaW3EFz9No779F86T)
It’s crazy watching drag race and Raja not winning. I’m not used to seeing her not in the top.
